column1: # Hand-written intents the per-turn hook checks first, most specific first. One per line:
# skill <TAB> pattern. A pattern is a POSIX ERE matched against the prompt lowercased, with
# punctuation turned to spaces and a space at each end, so ` bug ` is a whole word.
# A route belongs here only where a wrong match is rare: the hook's value is that it is believed.
